representations.name: Exact prime-predecessor hypergraph
representations.new_information: Represents every forbidden event by the exact edge g{pq,pr,qr}, retaining the common factor g and the identities of all three prime predecessors.
representations.repairs_loss: Restores precisely the overlap discarded when the inherited double count caps each product independently.
representations.first_test: Solve the maximum harmonic-weight independent-set MILP on H_N and inspect which scaled edges are tight.
representations.closure_interface: Needs a uniform weighted cover or charging argument whose total cost matches the prime-block scale.

representations.name: Primitive edge classes under gcd scaling
representations.new_information: Groups all edges into dilation orbits g{pq,pr,qr}, separating a primitive prime triangle from its harmonic sequence of scales.
representations.repairs_loss: Keeps common-gcd scaling visible instead of treating products at unrelated magnitudes as independent.
representations.first_test: Compare finite optima with and without nontrivial g and test whether a certificate tensorizes over dilation orbits.
representations.closure_interface: Any local primitive inequality must sum over g without an extra logarithmic loss.

representations.name: Prime-exponent lattice fibres
representations.new_information: Writes n as an exponent vector and each edge as three immediate predecessors of a vector in three distinct positive coordinates.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains repeated prime powers and exposes induction along coordinate fibres, which the squarefree Boolean cube deletes.
representations.first_test: Optimise exact weighted boxes {0,...,E}^k for increasing k and E and compare E=1 with E>=2.
representations.closure_interface: A candidate must remain valid under adjoining a coordinate and increasing every exponent depth.

representations.name: Squarefree Boolean cube with weighted levels
representations.new_information: Restricts to exponent vectors in {0,1}^k but keeps the genuine reciprocal-product vertex weights and all predecessor triples.
representations.repairs_loss: Provides the sharpest inexpensive falsifier for product-form and layer-form conjectures while recording exactly what is omitted.
representations.first_test: Compare MILP optima with one-prime-per-block and low-Hamming-layer constructions through k=12.
representations.closure_interface: Survival is necessary only; a separate lifting theorem to exponents and arbitrary primes would still be required.

representations.name: Weighted fractional-cover dual
representations.new_information: Dualises the finite harmonic independent-set relaxation into nonnegative edge prices plus vertex slacks, recording which local constraints pay for each 1/n weight.
representations.repairs_loss: Replaces a uniform multiplicity cap by an identity-aware certificate assembled from overlapping forbidden triples.
representations.first_test: Extract dual solutions for increasing N and fit prime-, scale-, and exponent-dependent formulas; reject formulas that fail exact constraint replay.
representations.closure_interface: A symbolic feasible dual with the conjectured total mass would immediately give the desired upper bound.

representations.name: Largest-prime owner flow
representations.new_information: Orients each forbidden triple and each unit of reciprocal weight toward a distinguished largest prime, turning overlap into a capacitated flow problem.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents the same selected integer from being charged independently at every product while preserving prime identity.
representations.first_test: Replay the flow on finite optima and measure overload on the smallest and largest prime coordinates.
representations.closure_interface: Requires a uniform capacity bound that sums to the target power of log N, not O(log N/log log N).

representations.name: Prime-block generating function
representations.new_information: Partitions primes by reciprocal mass and records weighted elementary symmetric polynomials of the selected exponent supports in each block.
representations.repairs_loss: Interfaces directly with the known lower construction and quantifies cross-block correlations rather than assuming independence.
representations.first_test: Evaluate candidate block inequalities on exact cube optima and deliberately correlated adjacent-block patterns.
representations.closure_interface: A tensorizable local inequality with controlled boundary errors would match the lower-bound mechanism.

representations.name: Entropy and random-prime deletion process
representations.new_information: Views a harmonically sampled selected integer through the random sequence of prime-coordinate deletions and records conditional entropy at each step.
representations.repairs_loss: Uses the at-most-two predecessor branching restriction dynamically instead of only counting final representations.
representations.first_test: Test proposed entropy drops on product measures, Hamming layers, and finite MILP extremisers.
representations.closure_interface: Needs an entropy-to-harmonic-mass conversion uniform in the number and sizes of prime coordinates.

representations.name: Logarithmic-scale Carleson packing
representations.new_information: Places vertices and scaled prime triangles in logarithmic intervals and asks whether tight constraints form a Carleson family across g-scales.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains harmonic scale and overlapping dilation orbits that disappear in unweighted hypergraph bounds.
representations.first_test: Measure scale occupancy and edge tightness of exact H_N optima; test nested adversarial dilations.
representations.closure_interface: A Carleson packing constant compatible with prime-block growth would sum without a full harmonic logarithm.

representations.name: Link graphs and two-shadow stability
representations.new_information: For each selected or omitted vertex, records the graph of pairs completing a scaled prime triangle, decorated by reciprocal weight and scale.
representations.repairs_loss: Captures overlap among triples and potential stability of near-extremisers beyond cardinality-only independence bounds.
representations.first_test: Compute weighted degrees, codegrees and link spectra on finite optima and on prime-block constructions.
representations.closure_interface: Would need a weighted stability theorem forcing an approximately product/block structure with summable error.
